verdict.rationale: Docs confirm New Relic dashboards support rich visualizations built via UI/NRQL and can be publicly shared via live dashboard URLs, satisfying most of the story. However, evidence does not explicitly mention template variables on dashboards, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the dashboard-building experience (community evidence focuses on pricing/UI complaints unrelated to dashboard features). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of template variables support, independent verification of dashboard usability/quality.
